kukui: Pulse PMIC_FORCE_RESET_ODL on external reset If the reset cause is external, it is wise to reset the PMIC registers, which can be achieved by pulsing the force reset signal to PMIC. We found in previous experiments that 5ms is often enough to reset the PMIC, but that occasionally the PMIC would auto-restart if the pulse is so short (so we pulse for 10s when we force shutdown the AP). Here, we pulse for 100ms, which is an acceptable delay in these situations, and hopefully long enough to recover from bad PMIC settings. BRANCH=none BUG=b:123154929 TEST=Boot kukui, external reset cause the PMIC to power cycle, measured using PMIC_EC_RESETB. TEST=AP normal reboot does not cause such a reset. TEST=See that most PMIC registers are reset after force reset is used (see bug). Change-Id: Iddbc20506890b3f904c36642515a0502d90462a3 Signed-off-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1490799 Reviewed-by: Yilun Lin <yllin@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: media: rockchip-vpu: Clear read cache before decoding The VDEC IP block includes a read cache, which is not coherent with writes coming out of the same block or from any other bus masters, including the CPU. Moreover, the cache is IOVA addressed, so when another buffer ends up mapped at the same IOVA, the cache could have stale entries for the old buffer. To fix the issue, the cache needs to be cleared. Ideally we would do that only if the buffer is dirty or a remap happened. However, clearing every frame did not lead to any performance effect above the measurement error, so let's just keep it simple. BUG=chromium:908314 BUG=b:123677023 TEST=video_VideoDecodeAccelerator.vp9.import on Kevin Change-Id: I2e2fd850c574c65149df68dfe4c4db2c84a3adbc Signed-off-by: Jeffy Chen <jeffy.chen@rock-chips.com> [tfiga: Added proper commit message.] Signed-off-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1517573 Commit-Ready: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org>
